label: id
comment: The globally unique ID of this conformity attestation.
A unique identifier for the declaration. Often this will be an extension of the product.id or attestation.id. But could be a UUID.

domainIncludes.comment: A conformity attestation issued by a competent body that defines one or more assessments (eg carbon intensity) about a product (eg battery) against a specification (eg LCA method) defined in a standard or regulation.
A specific assessment about the product or facility against a specific specification.  Eg the carbon intensity of a given product or batch.
